en.headline: Market Misconduct Tribunal finds Sir Dickson Poon culpable of insider dealing
en.dek: The tribunal ruled that the Dickson Concepts founder bought shares while in possession of inside information about a US$4 billion acquisition that later yielded the company about HK$1.15 billion in cash.
body: The Market Misconduct Tribunal on Friday found Sir Dickson Poon, founder and former group executive chairman of Dickson Concepts (International) Limited, and his investment holding company Equity Advantage Limited culpable of insider dealing in the company’s shares.

The Securities and Futures Commission said the case arose from PayPal Holdings’ acquisition of Honey Science Corporation for about US$4 billion in November 2019. At the time Dickson Concepts held roughly 3.73 per cent of Honey. After the deal completed, the company was entitled to about US$147.6 million, or approximately HK$1.15 billion, in cash, representing a gain of about HK$928.7 million over the investment’s book value.

The tribunal found that Poon became aware of the inside information on 21 November 2019 and described it as “wonderful news”. After a lock-up period expired on 28 November, he purchased a total of 2,756,500 Dickson Concepts shares through Equity Advantage over 13 trading days up to 19 December 2019, before the company had disclosed the matter to the market.

The tribunal also ruled that Dickson Concepts failed to disclose the inside information as soon as reasonably practicable. It attributed the breach to Poon’s deliberate decision not to inform other company officers, including the board, until transaction documents were received at the end of December 2019. Poon’s son, Pearson Poon, was found not responsible because he had reasonable grounds to rely on assessments by his father and other senior management.
The tribunal will determine sanctions and orders against Poon and the company at a later date. The SFC said it would continue to combat insider dealing and failures to disclose inside information.

zh.headline: 市場失當行為審裁處裁定潘廸生爵士內幕交易罪成
zh.dek: 審裁處裁定廸生創建創辦人兼前集團執行主席在掌握有關一項最終為公司帶來約11.5億港元現金交易的內幕消息下，買入公司股份。
body: 市場失當行為審裁處星期五裁定廸生創建（國際）有限公司創辦人兼前集團執行主席潘廸生爵士及其投資控股公司Equity Advantage Limited，在掌握內幕消息的情況下就該公司股份進行內幕交易罪成。
證監會表示，案件源於PayPal Holdings在2019年11月以約40億美元收購Honey Science Corporation一事。當時廸生創建持有Honey約3.73%已發行股本，收購完成後公司有權收取約1.476億美元（約11.5億港元）現金，按投資帳面值計獲利約9.287億港元。
審裁處裁定，潘廸生爵士於2019年11月21日得悉有關內幕消息，形容為「天大喜訊」。禁售期於11月28日屆滿後，他透過Equity在直至12月19日的13個交易日內合共買入275.65萬股廸生創建股份，當時公司尚未向市場披露有關消息。
審裁處進一步裁定廸生創建未有在合理切實可行範圍內盡快披露內幕消息，並指公司違規行為歸咎於潘廸生爵士蓄意不將消息告知其他人員包括董事會，直至2019年12月底收到交易文件時才知會。其子潘冠達則被裁定無須負責，因他有合理理由倚賴其父及其他高級管理層的評估。
審裁處將在稍後日期裁定對潘廸生爵士及公司的制裁及相應命令。證監會表示會繼續打擊內幕交易及公司披露失當行為。
